subject.title: fix(swarm): live agents.run fan-outs launch collectors

question: Should all in-process `agent` dispatches receive the gateway synthetic client identity, or should the trusted identity remain limited to a narrower host-owned call boundary?
rationale: The patch intentionally broadens the trusted identity selection at a gateway security boundary; code inspection available in the supplied PR context supports the swarm use case but cannot establish maintainer intent for every caller.

options.title: Approve the host-owned dispatch rule
options.body: Confirm that `callSubagentGateway` is reached only from host-owned in-process launch paths, then merge with the existing regression coverage.

options.title: Narrow the identity propagation
options.body: Require a dedicated host-owned dispatch signal if any in-process caller can originate from an untrusted plugin or external request path.

recommendation.title: Approve the host-owned dispatch rule
recommendation.body: Confirm that `callSubagentGateway` is reached only from host-owned in-process launch paths, then merge with the existing regression coverage.
